name: phr-foundry
description: PeoplesHR internal Claude Code marketplace. Distributes organization standards and tooling to engineering teams.

plugins.name: org-standards
plugins.description: PeoplesHR organization standards. Ships the phx-business-context skill for answering questions about PeoplesHR module behaviour, user flows and configuration in business terms, grounded in the product documentation held in WeKnora, and the weknora MCP server for read-only retrieval from the PeoplesHR knowledge bases. Business Analysts install this; developers install dev-kit instead, never both. The hands-on build skills and phx-product-context live in the dev-kit plugin; the SQL standards review and phx-dbexplorer live in the dba-kit plugin.

plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: PeoplesHR developer build tooling. Ships the hrm-deployment-script skill for reformatting SQL to PHR conventions in .NET Framework projects, the hrm-notification skill for building a Job Scheduler email notification for any module, the phx-debugger skill for fixing an Azure DevOps bug end to end from its bug ID, the hrm-configuration-document skill for writing the house Configuration Document (.md, .docx, PDF) for a finished CR, the phx-product-context skill for grounding answers about PeoplesHR module behaviour in the product documentation held in WeKnora, and the phx-write-sdd skill for authoring the Architecture / Solution Design Document (SDD) against the template held in the PHR-X project wiki. Declares the weknora MCP server. Safe alongside dba-kit or ba-kit, but never install it with org-standards. Install dba-kit for the phx-dbexplorer MCP server if you want schema browsing.

plugins.name: ba-kit
plugins.description: PeoplesHR tooling for Business Analysts. Ships the phx-write-frd skill for authoring the Feature Requirements Document (FRD) against the template held in the PHR-X project wiki, and the weknora MCP server for read-only retrieval from the PeoplesHR knowledge bases. phx-write-frd needs your own Azure DevOps MCP server. Business Analysts also install org-standards, which ships phx-business-context.

plugins.name: dba-kit
plugins.description: PeoplesHR database tooling for DBAs. Ships the phx-sql-standards-review skill for reviewing T-SQL against the OLD hSenid HRM or NEW PeoplesHR PHR-X SQL standards, and the phx-dbexplorer MCP server for browsing a SQL Server or Postgres schema. Both moved here from org-standards in its 4.0.0 release; safe to install alongside any other phr-foundry plugin.
